problem: Required browser verification failed although the preview homepage returned HTTP 200 with correct identity, visible content and no page errors, because Playwright emitted requestfailed for document:/.
root_cause: The verifier treated every same-origin document requestfailed event as an asset failure even when the settled top-level navigation succeeded. Preview/browser infrastructure can abort a superseded duplicate document request.
fix: Suppress only document:<final-path> when the final navigation response is successful. Keep script, stylesheet and unsuccessful document failures fail-closed.
failed_approaches: Treating every requestfailed document event as equivalent to a failed final page load.
Rerunning the identical browser job without changing the false-negative predicate.
prevention: Bind document request-failure severity to the settled navigation result.
Never suppress script or stylesheet failures.
Never suppress a document failure when final HTTP success is absent.
Keep route identity, visible content and page-error checks mandatory.
